# An enum whose members carry payloads, run on every target: construction,
# the selector read and its narrowing, a match binding each payload, equality
# and the zero value, in a function, a view and a handler.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// An enum member may carry a type, its payload: a value of the enum holds
// exactly one member, and that member's payload with it. It is built as a
// struct literal naming the one member, read by a selector that is present
// only when the member is the one held, and matched by member, where
// `match var v = s` names the payload of the member an arm names. A member
// with no payload is written as every member is.

import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Size {
    w float
    h float
}

struct Failure {
    message string
    code    int
}

enum Result[T any] {
    ok     T
    failed Failure
}

enum Shape {
    empty
    circle float
    rect   Size
}

// The first member is the zero value, with its payload's zero.
var held Shape

func area(s Shape) float {
    match var v = s {
        empty { return 0.0 }
        circle { return 3.0 * v * v }
        rect { return v.w * v.h }
    }
}

func label(r Result[int]) => match var v = r {
    ok => "ok {v}"
    failed => "failed: {v.message}"
}

func describe(s Shape) => match s {
    circle => "round"
    else => "not round"
}

// In an arm that names no member carrying a payload, the name is the subject.
func kind(s Shape) => match var v = s {
    circle => "round"
    else => "area {area(v)}"
}

func half(n int) Result[int] {
    if n % 2 != 0 {
        return {failed={message="odd", code=n}}
    }
    return Result[int]{ok=n / 2}
}

func orZero(r Result[int]) int {
    // The selector is an option, so the null test narrows it.
    if r.ok != null {
        return r.ok
    }
    return 0
}

component panel node {
    var shape Shape = Shape.empty
    var result = half(4)

    text #shownArea(value="{area(shape)}")
    text #outcome(value=label(result))
    text #radius(value=match var r = shape {
        circle => "{r}"
        else => "none"
    })
    match var r = shape {
        circle { text #round(value="radius {r}") }
        else {}
    }

    button #grow(text="Grow", @click {
        shape = match var r = shape {
            empty => {circle=1.0}
            circle => {circle=r + 1.0}
            rect => Shape.empty
        }
    })
    button #odd(text="Odd", @click { result = half(3) })
}

func testZero(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(held == Shape.empty)
    t.assert(held.empty)
    t.assert(area(held) == 0.0)
}

func testConstruct(t Test, c panel) {
    var s Shape = {circle=2.0}
    t.assert(area(s) == 12.0)
    t.assert(area(Shape{rect={w=2.0, h=3.0}}) == 6.0)
    t.assert(!s.empty)
}

func testSelector(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(half(4).ok == 2)
    t.assert(half(3).ok == null)
    t.assert(half(3).failed != null)
    t.assert(orZero(half(10)) == 5)
    t.assert(orZero(half(1)) == 0)
}

func testMatch(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(label(half(6)) == "ok 3")
    t.assert(label(half(5)) == "failed: odd")
    t.assert(describe({circle=1.0}) == "round")
    t.assert(describe(Shape.empty) == "not round")
    t.assert(kind({rect={w=2.0, h=3.0}}) == "area 6")
    t.assert(kind(Shape.empty) == "area 0")
}

func testEquality(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(half(4) == Result[int]{ok=2})
    t.assert(half(4) != Result[int]{ok=3})
    t.assert(half(3) != Result[int]{ok=3})
    var a Shape = {circle=1.0}
    var b Shape = {circle=1.0}
    t.assert(a == b)
    t.assert(a != Shape.empty)
}

func testComponent(t Test, c panel) {
    t.assert(c.shownArea.value == "0")
    t.assert(c.outcome.value == "ok 2")
    t.assert(c.radius.value == "none")
    t.assert(c.round == null)
    c.grow.click()
    t.assert(c.shownArea.value == "3")
    t.assert(c.radius.value == "1")
    t.assert(c.round != null)
    c.grow.click()
    t.assert(c.radius.value == "2")
    c.odd.click()
    t.assert(c.outcome.value == "failed: odd")
}
